notes: Encoded ONLY from Power-fin's own page text and examples. The page itself states these serial numbers are utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems of boilers, water heaters and pool heaters, and Power-fin is listed among those brands, so each style below is justified from this page alone; no content was imported from any Lochinvar-family file and this file does not change those files. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both chart-only) and page Style 7 (5Y013: month = 1st numerical digit, year = 2nd letter, both chart-only) — no year encodable from text. Page Styles 3, 4, 5, 6 ship YEAR-ONLY: year digits text-verified, month = 1st letter chart-only. Style 3 list/detail LENGTH DISCREPANCY: the list shows J-93001 (6 normalized characters) but the detail section shows J-93 0001 (7 normalized characters); only the 7-character detail form is encoded, because a 6-character form would collide with Style 6's shape and dual-form encoding requires disjointness. Style 5 list/detail DUAL FORM: list J93-1030F (8 normalized characters) and detail J93 12030F (9 normalized characters) both decode year [1,3] = '93' -> 1993, and the combined pattern is disjoint from every other style in this file, so both forms are encoded.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges.

Detail form J-93 0001 (normalized J930001). Page states year = 3rd & 4th characters with the 2nd character a dash (1-based raw counting), i.e. normalized positions [1,3] -> '93'. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. List form J-93001 not encoded (see brand notes).
Year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '07'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Dual form (see brand notes): list form J93-1030F and detail form J93 12030F both decode year [1,3] -> '93'. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '78'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Page states the last four digits represent year and month: year = 7th & 8th digits, month = 9th & 10th digits (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges.
